label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Some good news: Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November, and I’m genuinely delighted to welcome her.

Priya is a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) with nine years’ experience at a consultancy in Coventry. Having her alongside me will make a real difference to how quickly we can get your calculations and drawings back to you. If you meet her on a site visit, please say hello.

It’s also time I acknowledged that September and October weren’t good enough. Turnaround for beam calculations and drawings stretched to five or six weeks. Several of you waited far too long, and some were understandably unhappy.

That was my fault. I said yes to too much work on my own. Doing site visits all day and calculations until midnight wasn’t a sensible way to run things, and it certainly wasn’t giving you the service you should expect. I’m sorry to everyone affected, particularly those left chasing us while trying to keep their building work moving.

With Priya joining, our turnaround target for beam calculations and drawings is now **10 working days**. That’s a target, not a promise that every job will be identical, but we’re making a proper change to address the delays.

If you’re waiting on us now, your job hasn’t been forgotten. Please message me directly and I’ll give you an update on where it stands and what happens next.

There’s also a change to first site visits. **Visits taking place from 1 January 2027 will cost £95**, deducted from our fee if you go ahead with us. Around a third of free visits haven’t led to a job, and we need to make that time sustainable.

**Any visit already booked when this post is published stays free, whatever its date.** New bookings for visits before 1 January stay free too.

Thank you for sticking with us and for recommending us to your neighbours and friends. I’m really looking forward to welcoming Priya on Monday and getting things back where they should be.
